verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs claim it administers equity and stock option plans "globally" and "across jurisdictions", with Singapore-optimised SPVs. That gives a thin, generic basis for international option-plan management. Its valuation offering, however, is framed only as US 409A and ASC 820, and its IFRS/Ind AS financial reporting is expense reporting rather than non-US valuations. Missing for 10: any UK HMRC/EMI valuation support, documented country-specific option scheme types (e.g. EMI, CSOP), non-US valuation methodologies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
